invariant: EntityImageEmptyPackage resolves classDiagram.package.title and stores its RoundCorner diameter in Fashion before ClusterDecoration selects the concrete painter. An unknown packageStyle such as `stack` falls back to PackageStyle.FOLDER in SkinParam, so the resulting USymbolFolder must consume the package-title diameter. USymbolFolder uses a polygon only when the diameter is zero; otherwise every body corner has radius diameter/2 and the tab shoulder uses radius 1.5 times that radius.
causal_divergence: The first implementation now resolves and paints the correct package-title diameter, including Java's zero polygon branch. The independent checker accepted all nonzero held-outs but found that Rust still measures a zero-corner polygon as a path-shaped frontier. Java LimitFinder.drawUPolygon expands every polygon by HACK_X_FOR_POLYGON=10 on both horizontal sides, shifting a lone image right by 10 and widening its canvas by 20. Rust's empty_package_painted_frontier currently returns the unexpanded folder bounds.
planned_change: Keep the accepted path equations. When EntityImageEmptyPackage selects a folder/package painter and the resolved diameter is zero, model LimitFinder's polygon frontier as min_x=-10 and max_x=width+10 using the existing LIMIT_FINDER_POLYGON_OVERSCAN_X constant. Nonzero UPath folders retain their exact frontier. Preserve PackageStyle's supported-value set and unknown-value fallback; do not add `stack` as a supported packageStyle.
